payload_experiment.platform: macOS arm64; native Linux final budget measurements pending
payload_experiment.scope: Frozen WIP source copy, separate saved .output-A through .output-F. node_modules was symlinked to original checkout; later Nuxt builds shared its .cache/nuxt/.nuxt build directory. Not a fully cache-isolated experiment.
payload_experiment.measurement: Fresh Chromium context per route/locale, locale cookie, normal hydration, real production Nuxt server, synthetic API fixtures, Network.requestWillBeSent unique JS filenames through networkidle and visible page. Raw and Brotli are sums of corresponding saved output file bytes, not encodedDataLength wire transfers.
payload_experiment.classification_caution: A/B historical VeryLow vs other initial priority does not prove optional vs required. A eagerly prefetched selected required locale too; Profiler execution also includes NuxtLink speculative route/layout imports. Compare actual.all for A/B/C. C onward disable only HTML JS prefetch hints and move NuxtLink prefetch to real hover/focus, so no initial speculative JS was observed.

variants.A: Default Nuxt HTML script prefetch plus visibility-based NuxtLink prefetch; Memory alone async.
variants.B: Only build:manifest .js prefetch=false; visibility-based NuxtLink unchanged.
variants.C: B plus experimental.defaults.nuxtLink.prefetchOn interaction=true,visibility=false; Memory alone async.
variants.D: C plus About async; root CSR initial cookie locale fix synchronized.
variants.E: D plus all eight settings panels async; default suspensible=true.
variants.F: E plus local async panels suspensible=false so loadingComponent is rendered under Nuxt parent Suspense.

speculative_edges: @nuxt/vite-builder 4.5.1 dist/index.mjs build:manifest before normalized manifest consumption
source_findings.closed_about_chain: SettingsDialog static AboutSettings -> defaultRehypePlugins in app/core/markdown/plugins.ts -> top-level rehype-raw -> parse5; actual C parse5-containing JS chunk 226047 raw bytes.
source_findings.runtime_version_findings: Vue/reactivity/compiler 3.5.42 singleton; Reka 2.10.1 and query-core 5.90.20 single installed versions. No positive-rendered exact module id appears in multiple output chunks.
source_findings.whole_asset_growth_limit: Dependency updates and added features are proven source changes, but no same-source pre-update rebuild was run; do not attribute all whole-output growth byte-for-byte to dependency versions.
source_findings.lock_root_cause: @nuxt/kit 4.5.1 dist/index.mjs loadNuxtConfig switches later non-dev builds with existing .nuxt and no explicit buildDir to node_modules/.cache/nuxt/.nuxt. A shared node_modules symlink therefore shares the build lock/cache. All experiment build processes finished naturally; no lock was removed or ignored.

verification.C: 8 browser tests passed: six route/locale cases and real hover/focus preheat plus click navigation.
verification.D_E: Each six network cases passed; first-open About loading browser assertion failed and led to root-cause fix. Two interaction cases intentionally only ran in C.
verification.F: 7 browser tests passed: six route/locale cases plus About first-loading DOM observation and cached reopen; two previously proven C interaction cases skipped.
verification.source_regressions: 14 scoped unit files, 102 tests passed; async settings test uses real outer Suspense and deferred imports for all eight panels. Canonical app+tests typecheck passed; scoped lint passed.

payload_experiment.budget_policy: No budget changed in this experiment. Use final original-checkout native Linux output and same metric before setting or accepting route/whole-output budgets.
